principle: Primitive cascade backlog must have an activation order derived from blocker types and required evidence so active gates grow systematically without reintroducing dependency cycles.

waves.label: Normalize Lateral Policy
waves.principle: Break primitive dependency cycles by marking lateral coordination separately from upstream blockers.

waves.label: Vendor Source Evidence
waves.principle: Add local source manifests, generated bridges, CSS/license evidence, and vendor ownership before activating vendor-backed primitives.

waves.label: Docs Runtime Evidence
waves.principle: Prove FlowDocs consumes local Flow runtime/semantic evidence instead of owning behavior.

waves.label: Local Consumption Evidence
waves.principle: Prove primitives are consumed by components, patterns, templates, or exported contracts before activation.
